scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-for-the-periodic-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 363 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9cf0253f6b105302), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a nonnegative density F0 on T3 × R3, with bounded velocity support and Z T3×R3 F0(1 + |v|2 + | log F0|) dx dv < ∞, for which the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation has two distinct global admissible solutions, in the sense of Definition 2.1, with initial datum F0. On some common initial interval both solutions are strongly continuous in L1, and their collision gains and losses are integrable in space-time-velocity.
